name: @pipeworx/mcp-gnomad

tools.name: variant
tools.description: Variant by chr-pos-ref-alt (e.g. "1-55051215-G-A") or rsid (e.g. "rs1801133"). Coordinates must match the dataset's genome build: the default gnomad_r4 is GRCh38, so a GRCh37/hg19 position will not be found — pass dataset "gnomad_r2_1" for GRCh37.

tools.name: gene
tools.description: Gene info + its variants. Accepts gene symbol (e.g. "BRCA1") or Ensembl gene id. Variants are paged (default 500, max 2,000 per call); variants_page gives the exact total and next_offset.

limit.description: Variants to return, 1-2000. Default 500. gnomAD returns every variant with no limit of its own (BRCA1 has ~7,300), so the list is paged here; variants_page says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many variants first, for the next page (variants_page.next_offset). Default 0.

tools.name: region
tools.description: Variants in a genomic region (≤25kb recommended). You MUST say which genome build your start/stop are in via assembly — there is no default, because a position is valid in both builds and a wrong guess returns real variants from the wrong locus rather than an error. Variants are paged (default 500, max 2,000 per call); variants_page gives the exact total and next_offset.

assembly.description: REQUIRED. The genome build your start/stop are in: "GRCh38" (= hg38) or "GRCh37" (= hg19). There is no default, because every position is valid in both builds — an unstated build cannot be detected, only guessed wrong. Must agree with dataset: gnomad_r2_1* and exac are GRCh37, gnomad_r3*/r4* are GRCh38.

dataset.description: Default gnomad_r4 (GRCh38). gnomad_r2_1* and exac are GRCh37.

limit.description: Variants to return, 1-2000. Default 500. gnomAD returns every variant with no limit of its own (BRCA1 has ~7,300), so the list is paged here; variants_page says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many variants first, for the next page (variants_page.next_offset). Default 0.

tools.name: transcript
tools.description: Fetch gnomAD variant data for an Ensembl transcript (ENST…), returning transcript coordinates, gene symbol, chromosome position, and per-variant allele counts (ac/an) from exome and genome datasets. Variants are paged (default 500, max 2,000 per call); variants_page gives the exact total and next_offset.

limit.description: Variants to return, 1-2000. Default 500. gnomAD returns every variant with no limit of its own (BRCA1 has ~7,300), so the list is paged here; variants_page says how many exist and the next offset.

offset.description: Skip this many variants first, for the next page (variants_page.next_offset). Default 0.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Autocomplete-style search across gnomAD genes and variants by free-text query; returns matching Ensembl gene IDs with symbols, and matching variant IDs (an rsid resolves here). Use to resolve a partial gene name, symbol or rsid before calling gene or variant.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gnomad forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gnomad pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
